scope: Independent static peer check of repaired run/SW/06 against current SW05 and SW07

before.issue: Rear left support boot was nearly S-facing instead of SW-facing.

supportLegAxis.observation: The anatomical left rear support boot at lower screen right now has its toe visibly to the left of its ankle/heel and shows the SW side contour. The shin still runs into the same ankle; the prior isolated frontal/S toe projection in 05-06-07 is removed. Knee position and rear support role remain unchanged in the visual comparison.

oppositeLeg.observation: The anatomical right knee remains folded in recovery, with a single attached shoe; no copied neighbor pose, new extra foot or knee reversal is visible.

handsFoxCrystal.observation: Exactly two character hands remain attributable to two sleeves: left hand cradles one fox at chest; right hand holds one blue crystal. Shoulder-to-sleeve and wrist connections are intact; no extra cuff or floating hand appears.

headBodyScale.observation: Compared at full 1024 canvas with SW05 and SW07, face width, eye spacing and hair-skull mass remain in the same character size range. No new whole-body shrink/enlargement or large head-size jump is visible. This is a visual comparison, not a claim of exact pixel identity.

registration.observation: Current frame record uses identity registration on an already registered canvas, with whole-canvas native1254 to formal1024 downsample and no second0.8 transform. Visually, pelvis/shoulder level and head scale fit adjacent frames; support contact remains at the rear support band. Historical SW registration.applied.json still describes the earlier transform and is not presented as the current repair transform.

boundary: Static full-image/neighbor review only. Root owns normal and quarter-speed playback and final status. This reviewer changed no formal PNG, original diagnosis, contact, manifest, registration or shared review/status file.

processImageRetention.note: Process-image paths in historical visual evidence identify files viewed before cleanup; their SHA256 and disposition are preserved in the cleanup records.
